title: Credit card rewards → Floras
floras_mechanism: Banks, fintechs, or card issuers embed Floras into card transactions as a climate-linked reward. Instead of giving only cashback, points, or miles, qualifying card spend generates Floras in a consumer or enterprise wallet. The cardholder or company can allocate Floras toward verified sustainability projects, creating a rewards experience tied to climate action rather than generic financial perks.
pain_signals: difficulty differentiating cashback or points products
bank wants sustainable finance product for retail customers
loyalty program has no ESG narrative
younger consumers expect climate-conscious financial products
need for visible sustainability engagement without changing core banking infrastructure
budget_source: Card rewards budget; marketing budget; customer acquisition budget; ESG product innovation budget
safe_claims: Floras adds a climate-linked layer to everyday card rewards
Cardholders can allocate earned Floras toward verified sustainability projects
Floras helps differentiate card products in a crowded rewards market
The rewards analogy applies to mechanics, while Floras value is restricted to verified sustainability impact
conditional_claims: If the issuer already has sustainable banking goals, Floras can support customer-facing activation of those goals
If the card targets climate-conscious consumers, Floras can become a core product differentiator
If transaction categories are tagged, Floras issuance can be customized by spend category
avoid_claims: Floras eliminates the cardholder's personal footprint
The card guarantees emissions reduction for every transaction
Floras is the same as unrestricted cashback

output_templates.one_liner: Turn {company_name}'s card rewards into climate-linked impact instead of generic points.
output_templates.short_pitch: {company_name} can use Floras to create a differentiated card rewards experience where qualifying spend generates climate-designated value. Instead of only giving cashback or points, the cardholder earns Floras that can be allocated toward verified sustainability projects, creating a clearer ESG story and a more engaging loyalty proposition.

objections_and_responses.objection: Our rewards program is already competitive—we don't need another feature.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras is not a generic perk add-on; it gives card products a distinct climate-linked narrative in a crowded rewards market. Issuers can position Floras as ESG-aligned differentiation without rebuilding core card infrastructure.

objections_and_responses.objection: Consumers want cashback, not climate credits.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras can complement existing rewards rather than replace them. The strongest positioning targets climate-conscious segments and gives issuers a sustainability story that standard cashback cannot provide.

objections_and_responses.objection: Regulatory and compliance risk on green claims.
objections_and_responses.response: Floras value is restricted to verified sustainability project allocation, not unrestricted cash. Claims should stay within safe-claim boundaries and tie issuance to documented project outcomes and certificates.
